description.en: Compare ten work priorities in 30 original four-option choices. Read all counts, shared ranks and ten full free guides. No job-fit percentage or hiring verdict.
description.zh: 通过30道原创四选一比较十项工作优先事项，查看全部次数、并列名次和十份免费完整读法；不输出岗位适配百分比或录用结论。

seoTitle.en: Values Assessment: Work Priorities & Full Free Results
seoTitle.zh: 工作价值观测试：十项工作取舍与免费完整结果

introduction.en: What would you protect first when a workable role cannot offer every attractive benefit? Compare Achievement, Autonomy, Creativity, Security, Altruism, Recognition, Relationships, Learning, Work-Life Balance and Impact. These ten editorial work priorities and all thirty questions are independently written for this edition. They differ from Schwartz basic human values, RIASEC activity interests and the six O*NET work values; this is not their questionnaire or a standardized job-match instrument. All ten complete guides are open before you start.
introduction.zh: 一份可行岗位无法同时提供所有好处时，你最先保护什么？比较成就、自主、创意、稳定保障、助人、认可、关系、学习、工作生活平衡和实际影响。十项编辑定义的工作优先事项与三十道题均为本版独立编写；它们不同于Schwartz基本价值、RIASEC活动兴趣或O*NET六项工作价值，不是这些题本或标准岗位匹配工具。十份完整指南开测前全部开放。

instructions.en: Imagine one ordinary next work role and keep that setting throughout. Assume the basic role is feasible and fair pay, safety and legal conditions are already required; those are not benefits to trade away. In each question choose the one offered condition you would protect first, even if several matter or none is ideal. The four conditions are assumed feasible for that imagined comparison, not promises about real employers. You can stop if the task does not fit. Finish all thirty choices before any counts or interpretation. No correct answers, reverse keys, purchases or personal workplace details are needed.
instructions.zh: 设想一份普通的下一阶段工作，始终使用同一背景。假设岗位基本可行，公平薪酬、安全和法律条件已经满足，不能把这些基本要求当作必须放弃的好处。每题在四项中选最先保护的一项，即使多项都重要或都不理想。题中假设这些条件在设想比较中均可行，并非真实雇主承诺。任务不适合时可以退出；三十题全部完成后才显示次数与读法。没有正确答案、反向键、消费任务，也无需个人单位细节。

prompt.en: A next role can reliably protect one of these benefits. Which matters most to you?
prompt.zh: 下一份岗位能可靠保留以下一项好处，你最看重哪项？

label.en: Choose my method within an agreed brief.
label.zh: 在约定要求内自己选择方法。

label.en: Make it easier for someone who needs practical help.
label.zh: 给需要实际帮助的人提供便利。

label.en: Generate an original idea rather than only repeat a template.
label.zh: 提出新想法，而非只重复模板。

label.en: Finish a demanding assignment to a clear standard.
label.zh: 把有难度的任务做到明确标准。

prompt.en: When comparing otherwise workable offers, which promise would you check first?

label.en: Receive clear credit for my contribution.
label.zh: 自己的贡献获得清楚署名或肯定。

label.en: Know that the role is expected to continue.
label.zh: 知道这份岗位预计能够持续。

label.en: Reach an agreed milestone that shows what I accomplished.
label.zh: 达到约定里程碑，看清自己完成了什么。

label.en: See what changed because the work was used.
label.zh: 看到工作被使用之后带来了什么变化。

prompt.en: Before joining a project, which condition would you most want to preserve?
prompt.zh: 加入项目前，你最想保留哪项条件？

label.en: Make room for an unusual but workable concept.
label.zh: 为不常见但可行的构想留出空间。

label.en: Decide the order of tasks I am responsible for.
label.zh: 自己决定负责事项的先后顺序。

label.en: Have others acknowledge the part I played.
label.zh: 让他人承认我发挥的作用。

label.en: Develop a skill I do not yet have.
label.zh: 发展一项自己尚未掌握的技能。

prompt.en: A team is planning an ordinary month. Which benefit would you prioritize?
prompt.zh: 团队安排普通一个月的工作时，你优先哪项好处？

label.en: Design a fresh way to present or solve something.
label.zh: 设计一种新的呈现或解决方式。

label.en: Get specific recognition when my work goes well.
label.zh: 工作做得好时获得具体认可。

label.en: Have reliable information about when pay will arrive.
label.zh: 清楚工资何时到账，而且安排可靠。

label.en: Keep a dependable stopping time for work.
label.zh: 有可靠的下班界限。

prompt.en: A manager asks what would make a role worthwhile to you. Which answer comes first?
prompt.zh: 负责人问什么会让这份岗位值得做，你先选哪项？

label.en: Protect time for responsibilities outside the job.
label.zh: 保护工作以外责任所需的时间。

label.en: Build trusting day-to-day connections with colleagues.
label.zh: 与同事建立日常互信的连接。

label.en: Spend part of my work directly supporting another person.
label.zh: 把部分工作用于直接支持他人。

label.en: Have my contribution noticed in feedback.
label.zh: 反馈中能看到自己的贡献被注意。

prompt.en: A role is being redesigned. Which part would you protect first?
prompt.zh: 岗位重新设计时，你最先保护哪部分？

label.en: Produce work whose quality I can check against a target.
label.zh: 让工作质量可以对照目标检查。

label.en: Try a small prototype of an idea I have invented.
label.zh: 把自己构想的点子做成小原型。

label.en: Have time to understand how something unfamiliar works.
label.zh: 有时间理解陌生事物怎样运作。

label.en: Have people at work with whom I can speak openly.
label.zh: 工作中有可以坦诚交流的人。

prompt.en: You can ask one question about a possible assignment. Which benefit would it concern?
prompt.zh: 对于可能承担的任务，你能先问一个问题，会先问哪项好处？

label.en: Organize my working day within agreed hours.
label.zh: 在约定工时内自己安排一天。

label.en: Be credited accurately when a team result is presented.
label.zh: 展示团队成果时，自己的贡献被准确标明。

label.en: Combine existing elements into a new approach.
label.zh: 把已有要素组合成新的做法。

label.en: Work to a reasonably predictable schedule.
label.zh: 工作日程大体可以预期。

prompt.en: A team has room to improve one part of ordinary working life. Which would you choose?
prompt.zh: 团队能改善日常工作的一部分，你会先选哪项？

label.en: Select the tools that suit my way of working.
label.zh: 自己选择适合工作方式的工具。

label.en: Receive feedback that helps me learn a new technique.
label.zh: 获得有助于学习新技术的反馈。

label.en: Have genuine time off without routine work messages.
label.zh: 休息时不被日常工作消息持续占据。

label.en: Trace my contribution to a practical downstream result.
label.zh: 能够追踪自己的贡献产生了什么后续结果。

prompt.en: While considering a fresh opportunity, which condition would carry most weight?
prompt.zh: 考虑新机会时，哪项条件对你最有分量？

label.en: Feel a steady sense of connection with the team.
label.zh: 与团队保持稳定的连接感。

label.en: Know who used the output and what it made possible.
label.zh: 知道产出被谁使用，以及促成了什么。

label.en: Receive enough notice before major changes to the role.
label.zh: 岗位重大变化前能提前获得通知。

label.en: Help a person get through a task they would struggle with alone.
label.zh: 帮助一个人完成独自处理会有困难的事。

prompt.en: A project can offer one of these advantages more consistently. Which would you request?
prompt.zh: 项目可以更稳定地提供以下一项优势，你会要求哪项？

label.en: Turn a difficult problem into a completed deliverable.
label.zh: 把棘手问题变成完成的交付成果。

label.en: Work with people who take time to understand one another.
label.zh: 与愿意花时间互相理解的人共事。

label.en: Make routine decisions without repeated approval.
label.zh: 普通决定无需反复请示。

label.en: Use my time to respond to another person’s concrete need.
label.zh: 用自己的时间回应他人的具体需要。

prompt.en: You are writing a private checklist for your next role. Which item would you put first?
prompt.zh: 给下一份岗位写私人清单时，你把哪项排在前面？

label.en: Include service to other people in my ordinary responsibilities.
label.zh: 让日常职责包含为他人服务。

label.en: Use my existing abilities to meet a challenging goal.
label.zh: 运用已有能力完成有挑战的目标。

label.en: Maintain room for rest alongside work commitments.
label.zh: 承担工作同时保留休息空间。

label.en: See good work acknowledged rather than taken for granted.
label.zh: 好的工作得到肯定，而非被视为理所当然。

prompt.en: A team asks what you would most dislike losing from this list. Which would you protect?
prompt.zh: 团队问以下哪项最不想失去，你会保护哪项？

label.en: Develop respectful relationships beyond exchanging task updates.
label.zh: 除了任务进度交流，还能建立尊重的关系。

label.en: Keep workload within the hours we agreed.
label.zh: 让工作量落在约定工时之内。

label.en: Have discretion over how I meet an agreed target.
label.zh: 对于怎样实现约定目标拥有裁量空间。

label.en: Have a fair chance to be known for what I contributed.
label.zh: 有公平机会让别人知道自己作了什么贡献。

prompt.en: Two suitable directions remain open. Which benefit would you use as your first comparison?
prompt.zh: 两个方向都可行时，你先用哪项好处来比较？

label.en: See a concrete improvement beyond merely finishing the task.
label.zh: 除了任务完成，还能看到具体改善。

label.en: Develop several imaginative alternatives before choosing one.
label.zh: 先发展几个有想象力的备选方案。

label.en: Build knowledge that goes beyond my current routine.
label.zh: 积累超出当前日常工作的知识。

label.en: Have room for mutual support among colleagues.
label.zh: 同事之间有相互支持的空间。

prompt.en: Before accepting a new responsibility, which condition would you clarify first?
prompt.zh: 接受新职责之前，你会先问清哪项条件？

label.en: Have stable arrangements for the next several months.
label.zh: 未来几个月的工作安排保持稳定。

label.en: Have a concrete standard for knowing a task is done well.
label.zh: 有具体标准判断任务是否做得好。

label.en: Get to know the people I work alongside.
label.zh: 有机会了解身边一起工作的人。

label.en: Shape my workflow instead of following every prescribed step.
label.zh: 自行组织流程，而非每一步都被规定。

prompt.en: A team wants to know what you hope to gain from the work. Which answer fits best?
prompt.zh: 团队想了解你希望从工作中获得什么，哪项最合适？

label.en: Try a task that teaches me something new.
label.zh: 尝试一项能够学到新东西的任务。

label.en: Have enough personal time after a demanding work period.
label.zh: 高强度工作之后仍有足够个人时间。

label.en: Understand the conditions under which my contract continues.
label.zh: 清楚合同继续有效的条件。

label.en: Complete something I can regard as a solid accomplishment.
label.zh: 完成一件自己认为扎实的成果。

prompt.en: When planning a next step, which of these benefits would you give priority?
prompt.zh: 规划下一步时，你优先考虑以下哪项好处？

label.en: Plan non-work commitments without frequent last-minute disruption.
label.zh: 安排工作以外事项时，不经常被临时打乱。

label.en: Avoid having core job arrangements change without warning.
